pages.text: The Aether is an aerial T2 dimension. Vertical combat, boss dungeons, and unique Aether materials.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Three major bosses (Slider, Valkyrie Queen, Sun Spirit) each drop Simply Swords uniques. The Aether introduces aerial combat as the primary challenge.$(br2)$(bold)Mechanics:$(/bold) Falling damage is doubled in the Aether. No natural regen while airborne. Ranger class is especially effective here.
$(bold)Materials:$(/bold) Zanite, Gravitite, and Ambrosium are Aether-native materials. Gravitite armor has a natural levitation effect — useful but costs you ground stability.

$(bold)No guide book.$(/bold) The Aether is exploration-driven — the Silver Dungeon, Gold Dungeon, and Obsidian Pinnacle each have discoverable lore. The $(bold)Book of Lore$(/bold) found in dungeons provides in-world narrative context.
